detailed_descriptions.en: Mix and match flashy combat techniques, gameplay-altering equippables, and evolvable abilities. Create an unstoppable team from the 20+ playable characters to blast through 50+ story missions and more in this action-packed adventure. Utawarerumono: ZAN is back and it's better than ever! BEYOND MASK OF DECEPTION The primary story mode follows the plot of Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth , including many new, fully-voiced scenes original to Utawarerumono: ZAN 2 that expand the breadth of the world and the depth of the characters! 3D HACK-AND-SLASH REBORN ZAN 2 improves on its predecessor in every way, with a new Skill Board system and refined hack-and-slash elements that allow for a renewed focus on character exploration and growth. Meanwhile, the new base system allows you to explore Oshtor's estate in Ennakamuy, where you can interact with your companions, progress the story, strengthen your characters, and more. You can even upgrade the base's functionality using points obtained in the course of gameplay! ANIMATED STORYTELLING No paper dolls here! 3D animated story cutscenes give every pivotal moment the sense of weight and place that it deserves, bringing the adventure to life like never before. DREAM ONLINE Co-op or in single player, the Dream Arena mode brings enemies, challenges, and maps that wouldn't be possible within the scope of the regular story. Play online with friends from around the world!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Mix and match flashy combat techniques, gameplay-altering equippables, and evolvable abilities. Create an unstoppable team from the 20+ playable characters to blast through 50+ story missions and more in this action-packed adventure. Utawarerumono: ZAN is back and it's better than ever!

BEYOND MASK OF DECEPTION

The primary story mode follows the plot of Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth, including many new, fully-voiced scenes original to Utawarerumono: ZAN 2 that expand the breadth of the world and the depth of the characters!

3D HACK-AND-SLASH REBORN

ZAN 2 improves on its predecessor in every way, with a new Skill Board system and refined hack-and-slash elements that allow for a renewed focus on character exploration and growth.
Meanwhile, the new base system allows you to explore Oshtor's estate in Ennakamuy, where you can interact with your companions, progress the story, strengthen your characters, and more. You can even upgrade the base's functionality using points obtained in the course of gameplay!

ANIMATED STORYTELLING

No paper dolls here! 3D animated story cutscenes give every pivotal moment the sense of weight and place that it deserves, bringing the adventure to life like never before.

DREAM ONLINE

Co-op or in single player, the Dream Arena mode brings enemies, challenges, and maps that wouldn't be possible within the scope of the regular story. Play online with friends from around the world!
